Position Description

CGI Federal is seeking a skilled Software Developer to design, develop, and deploy software applications that enhance business processes and streamline operations. This role is ideal for developers who are eager to advance their technical skills and grow within the company. We offer a supportive environment with opportunities for training and mentorship to help you develop your career.

This position is located in Arlington, VA.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Develop, test, and deploy software applications.

Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

Collaborate with cross functional teams to define software requirements.

Participate in code reviews and maintain best practices.

Troubleshoot and debug software issues.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

1–6 years of experience in software development or related technical roles.

Experience with Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.

Strong understanding of programming languages such as JavaScript/React, C#, Python, and SQL.

Experience in integrating applications with various data sources and APIs.

Strong problem solving, debugging, and analytical skills.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Desired qualifications/non essential skills required:

Familiarity with modern development practices, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies.

Cloud certifications (e.g., Azure Developer, Azure Solutions Architect) are a plus.

CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $58,000.00 $136,200.00.
